title: Package.resolved pin that follows a branch
description: Package.resolved declares a resolved pin whose state keeps a branch name. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a resolved pin whose state keeps a branch name.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a resolved pin whose state keeps a branch name.
limitation: It matches a resolved pin whose state keeps a branch name in the parsed Package.resolved; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
